expectations.text: 严格遵循 IEC 60947-2:2024 英式拼写与连字符规范：正文全部使用 moulded-case circuit-breaker / circuit-breaker（无未连字符 circuit breaker 或美式 molded）、withdrawable（非 drawout/drawer）、aluminium（非 aluminum）、utilisation（非 utilization）及 colour（非 color）
expectations.evidence: Body L1, L11, L13: "moulded-case circuit-breakers", "withdrawable versions", "aluminium conductors", "utilisation category AC-22", "colour shall not be red or green"; zero US spellings (molded/aluminum/utilization/color/drawout) or unhyphenated "circuit breaker".

expectations.text: 准确译出 Annex B（CBR）术语与符号：circuit-breaker incorporating residual current protection (CBR)、Type B、rated residual operating current（IΔn）与 rated residual short-circuit making and breaking capacity（IΔm），未误译为 ELCB / RCCB / leakage breaker
expectations.evidence: Body L13 & Table L29-33: "Circuit-breaker incorporating residual current protection (CBR)", "Type B", "rated residual operating current I_Δn (Cl. B.4.2.1)", "rated residual short-circuit making and breaking capacity I_Δm (Cl. B.4.1.3)"; L57 distinguishes CBR from RCCB/RCBO.

expectations.text: 准确译出 Annex H（IT 系统）术语与符号：引用 Annex H、IT systems、I_IT（或 IIT），并译出不适用电压标示带叉 IT 符号（crossed-out IT）
expectations.evidence: Body L14 & Table L34-35: cites Annex H (Cl. H.2–H.5, Table H.2), "IT systems", I_IT, and "crossed-out IT symbol (IEC 60417-6363:2016-07)".

expectations.text: 准确译出 Annex P（光伏直流）术语与规则：使用 DC circuit-breaker for use in photovoltaic (PV) applications（或 PV circuit-breaker / PV DC circuit-breaker，不用 solar DC breaker），引用 Annex P（含 P.1/P.5/P.7.2/P.8.3.9 等），译出双向（forward and reverse）分断及 critical DC load current（Test Sequence VII / 9.3.10 / P.8.3.9）
expectations.evidence: Body L15 & Table L36-38: "DC circuit-breaker for use in photovoltaic (PV) applications (PV circuit-breaker)", cites Annex P (Cl. P.1, P.4, P.5, P.7.2, P.8.3.2, P.8.3.9, Table P.2 marking "IEC 60947-2:2024, Annex P"), "non-polarized interruption of both forward and reverse currents", "Test Sequence VII for critical DC load current (Cl. 9.3.10 & Cl. P.8.3.9)".

expectations.text: 准确译出 Annex A 上下级配合术语与符号：使用 selectivity（禁用 discrimination）、selectivity limit current（Is）、连字符 back-up protection（禁用 backup）与 take-over current（IB，禁用 transfer current / handover current）
expectations.evidence: Body L16 & Table L39-41: "selectivity" (no discrimination), "selectivity limit current I_s (Cl. 8.2.7, Cl. A.5)", hyphenated "back-up protection (Cl. A.6)", and "take-over current I_B (Cl. 9.3.8, Annex A)".

expectations.text: 准确译出 Annex D（aluminium conductors / unprepared round aluminium conductors，D.8.5）与 Annex L（CBI / circuit-breaker not fulfilling the requirements for overcurrent protection，utilisation category AC-22，L.4.1）
expectations.evidence: Body L11 & Table L26-28: Annex D ("aluminium conductors", "unprepared round aluminium conductors", Cl. D.1/D.3/D.5.2/D.8.5) and Annex L ("circuit-breaker not fulfilling the requirements for overcurrent protection (CBI)", "utilisation category AC-22", Cl. L.1–L.5, Cl. L.4.1 Note).

expectations.text: 所引用的 IEC 60947-2:2024 条款号全部为 2024 第 6 版有效条款（如 Cl. 3.5/4.4/8.1.2/8.2.7/8.2.8/9.3.8/9.3.10 及 Annex A/B/D/H/L/P 子条款），未混入作废的 Ed. 5.x 旧编号（如 Cl. 2.x、Cl. 4.3.x、Cl. 7.2.x、Cl. 8.3.x）
expectations.evidence: All cited clauses verified 100% against IEC 60947-2:2024 Ed. 6.0 clause_index.json (Cl. 3.1/3.5/4.4/5.3.2.1/8.1.2/8.1.6/8.2.7/8.2.8/9.3.3.3/9.3.8/9.3.10 and Annex A/B/D/H/K/L/P subclauses); zero obsolete Ed. 5.x clause numbers.

expectations.text: 数值与单位之间保留单个半角空格（1 500 V DC 或 1500 V DC，无 1500V 粘连），且未为原文未提供的产品参数（如 IΔn、IΔm、I_IT、Is、IB）编造具体额定数值
expectations.evidence: Body L15 uses half-width spaced "1 500 V DC" (no "1500V"); L70 explicitly confirms zero fabricated product ratings (I_Δn, I_Δm, I_IT, I_s, I_B, etc.), separating standard ceilings from product claims.
